# Thirza Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** At least fifty years of age  <sub>[v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c8 P11](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0011), [v1 c9 P0](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker and cook  <sub>[v1 c16 P27](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0027)</sub>

## Appearance

Thirza is tall and slender with a lean form, sharp angles, and a wrinkled face. Her silvered dark hair is bound at the back in a tight, firm bun fastened by wire hairpins. Around her mouth lies a redeeming expression that hints at a underlying humorous nature.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c33 P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015), [v1 c34 P6](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0006)_

## Personality

Thirza is a rational, practical, and matter-of-fact woman with a strict sense of morality and decorum. Though often stern, tart, and fault-finding in her speech, she holds a deep, reserved affection for her family and possesses an underlying sense of humor. She refrains on principle from voicing opinions on ministers and prefers substantial utility over ornamental luxury. In her later years, her demeanor becomes noticeably mellowed.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c7 P19](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0019), [v1 c8 P44](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0044), [v1 c21 P4](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0004), [v1 c21 P26](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0026), [v1 c23 P25](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0025), [v1 c26 P1](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0001), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c38 P46](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0046)_

## Traits

- Strict and fault-finding  <sub>[v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003)</sub>
- Fond of attaching moral lessons to her words  <sub>[v1 c5 P12](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0012), [v1 c8 P41](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0041)</sub>
- Reserved in expressing affection  <sub>[v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c34 P7](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0007), [v1 c37 P20](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0020)</sub>
- Practical and matter-of-fact  <sub>[v1 c21 P23](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0023), [v1 c23 P25](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0025), [v1 c26 P1](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0001)</sub>

## Abilities

- Cooking and baking  <sub>[v1 c16 P27](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0027), [v1 c21 P16](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0016)</sub>
- Baking baking-powder biscuits  <sub>[v1 c21 P16](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0016)</sub>
- Making yellow plum preserves  <sub>[v1 c21 P16](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0016)</sub>
- Making famous homemade currant wine  <sub>[v1 c16 P46](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0046)</sub>

## Goals

- Properly raise and educate Nell Harcourt to be self-sufficient and morally upright  <sub>[v1 c19 P89](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0089), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), [v1 c30 P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016)</sub>

## History

Thirza Abernethy resides at Grey Shutters alongside her brother Obed. Having arranged to adopt an orphan boy to assist on their farm, they receive Nell Harcourt by mistake; though initially intent on rectifying the error through Mrs. Tranter, Thirza ultimately decides to keep and raise Nell. She instills discipline, homemaking skills, and proper decorum in the imaginative girl, despite frequent domestic mishaps involving baking disasters, ruined pudding sauces, and mislaid wine. Over time, Thirza grows deeply attached to Nell, supporting her education through high school. She attends political gatherings in Port Marlow as a Conservative supporter and remains an active participant in the local Aid Society. When Obed's heart condition worsens and he eventually collapses and dies, Thirza draws comfort from Nell, expressing the maternal love she had long kept guarded beneath her stern exterior.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031), [v1 c6 P3](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0003), [v1 c6 P29](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0029), [v1 c12 P46](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0046), [v1 c16 P27](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0027), [v1 c16 P46](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0046), [v1 c18 P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 c18 P41](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0041), [v1 c27 P3](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0003), [v1 c30 P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016), [v1 c30 P38](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0038), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P20](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0020)_

## Background by volume

- Was called a dark, homely little thing by an aunt during her childhood  <sub>[v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044)</sub>
- Was close friends in her youth with John Carrow, who was considered her suitor  <sub>[v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037)</sub>
- Moved into Grey Shutters after reaching adulthood  <sub>[v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031)</sub>
- Inherited an amethyst brooch framing her mother's hair from her mother  <sub>[v1 c13 P20](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0020)</sub>
- Wallpapered a spare bedroom four years prior with Obed's assistance  <sub>[v1 c10 P6](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0006)</sub>

## Quotes

> It likely is not important what an individual is called provided that he conducts himself properly  <sub>[v1 c5 P12](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0012)</sub>

> I accept what you say  <sub>[v1 c21 P8](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0008)</sub>

> Obed had a bad spell with his heart Thursday, and leaving him didn't feel right to me. Oh, yes, now he's all right again, but those spells come on him more frequently than they used to, so I'm worried for him.  <sub>[v1 c30 P38](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0038)</sub>

> My love for you is as deep as though you were my very own child, and from the moment you arrived at Grey Shutters, you have brought me nothing but happiness and solace.  <sub>[v1 c37 P20](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0020)</sub>
